notes: v1.14.540 — LEGACY-RETIRE STAGE 3.2a: THE ACTION STRIPE IS DELETED. 229 lines, 12,795 bytes — the largest single removal of the campaign. Out: #action-stripe markup, both body.rd hide rules, actionStripe_renderRackToolbar / _refresh / _isOff / _syncLabel / _toggle, ACTION_STRIPE_OFF_KEY, the _stripeViewContext machinery (stripeView_setRack / stripeView_clear) and its two call sites, the #hdr-stripe-btn menu item, and the 15-second refresh interval with its visibilitychange pause. ⛔ THE STRIPE MONKEY-PATCHED showPage. A wrapper at :57289 intercepted EVERY navigation in BOTH houses purely to re-run the stripe; deleting the functions without it would have thrown on every page change. showPage is now the plain function again — it was the only wrapper in the file. ⭐ AND IT WAS DOING REAL WORK FOR AN INVISIBLE BAR: #action-stripe is display:none under body.rd but still in the DOM, so the 15s interval ran deploy_loadAll + deploy_computeDeployRollup on a timer, forever, in the redesign, to paint a hidden element — plus once more 100ms after every navigation. ⛔ KEPT DELIBERATELY: stripeRack_logNote is SHARED — the redesign's own LOG NOTE door (.172, which un-stranded it) and the rack-detail action list at :22570 both call it. And --action-stripe-reserve SURVIVES this ship on purpose: dropping it moves layout in the REDESIGN (five sheet inners reclaim 106px), which is a second, separate visible change and gets its own ship and verify as 3.2b. Those sheets are inset:0 overlays at z-index 150–200 sitting ABOVE #rd-botnav at z-index 40, so the reserve was never nav clearance and the .532 tuck trap does not apply. Visible under ?legacy=1 only: the bottom action bar is gone, and its ACTION STRIPE ON/OFF item leaves the overflow menu.
